associations.rationale: This only defines the semidirect-product presentation used in the derivation and does not state the dihedral representation classification.
The group equivalence enables transport from the semidirect presentation to the dihedral group but does not itself classify representations.
The type directly states the exhaustive dihedral classification, with irreducibility, pairwise nonisomorphism, dimensions, and parity-dependent counts.
This classifies the auxiliary semidirect-product presentation and is the intermediate result used to derive the classification for the dihedral group.
